channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nate Robinson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nate Robinson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tony Allen on Danny Ainge, Nate Robinson
item.description:
Tony Allen:

“It was no greater feeling—I ain’t even gonna lie— than to beat Doc. Like I say, man, I told a lot of websites this, a lot of podcasts this. You know, I was in Boston before I came to Memphis. Like I said, I asked Doc and Danny Ainge, 'Hey, man, give me a third year.' They wanted to re-sign me to the same deal, but they put a lot of belief in Nate Robinson—shoutout Nate Robinson. But after winning the championship and going to the finals, you know, I thought I was embedded in the team. I thought I was family to the Celtics, you know what I’m saying?”

Tony Allen on Danny Ainge, Nate Robinson, Nov 24, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Deron Williams on Nate Robinson
item.description:
“I watched it. I'm not Nate Robinson. I think I have a little more experience than Nate. I've been training stand-up and boxing for 8-10 years,”

Deron Williams on Nate Robinson, Nov 17, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Carlos Boozer on Nate Robinson
item.description:
Carlos Boozer on Nate Robinson:

“Every road trip he'd bake us cupcakes for the road. Straight Up, the best teammate I ever had.”

Carlos Boozer on Nate Robinson, May 31, 2017. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Brian Shaw on Nate Robinson
item.description:
KC Johnson:Shaw on Robinson:

“One minute you love him, the next minute you want to put your hands around his neck. He can shoot you in, shoot you out.”

Brian Shaw on Nate Robinson, Jan 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Kendrick Perkins, Nate Robinson, Jermaine O'Neal
item.description:
Kevin Garnett:

“The team with Shaq, Bib Baby, Kendrick Perkins, Jermaine O'Neal, Nate Robinson... That was probably the most fun I've had since I've been in the league... That team was a character. [...] There was never a dull moment in that locker room. I wish we got Shaq earlier in his career... That was a cool team.”

Kevin Garnett on Kendrick Perkins, Nate Robinson, Jermaine O'Neal, Sep 10, 2012. Source: YouTube.
